tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen. Warm, never pure white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, sheets, inputs and unselected chips on paper.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Fact chips inside cards, neutral tags, quiet secondary buttons.

tokens.name: stack
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, the card peeking behind the swipe card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Unchecked checkbox ring, dashed borders on unset chips and add rows, off-switch track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text. Numbered step badges.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and every neutral icon stroke.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, section labels, quantities, overlines. 4.9:1 on paper.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, chevrons, empty-day text. Decorative only: 2.8:1, never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and on the strong sage and iris fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Terracotta. The one primary action per screen, the active day, selected checkboxes, switches that are on.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Terracotta text and links on paper and surface.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft: selected chips, suggested tags.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chip fill, active tab pill, planned-day circle, 'On a remarqué' card.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Reminder block background (with the dashed accent-dash border).

tokens.name: accent-dash
tokens.usage: Dashed border of reminder blocks.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Courses / at home / done: owned-ingredient checks, 'cooked' marks, fit dot.

tokens.name: sage-strong
tokens.usage: Sage text on paper and sage-soft; fill of the compact groceries button.

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Groceries card background, 'à la maison' tags.

tokens.name: iris
tokens.usage: P (the partner): avatar, progress bars.

tokens.name: iris-strong
tokens.usage: Text on iris-soft; fill of buttons about P (white text 5.2:1).

tokens.name: iris-soft
tokens.usage: Cards and tags about P: waiting state, her allergies.

tokens.name: person-1
tokens.usage: You (V): avatar fill and your share in bars. Initials are decorative, the name is always nearby.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: The 'indispensable' star only. Never a surface.

tokens.name: star-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the indispensable tag and button.

tokens.name: star-text
tokens.usage: Text of the indispensable tag (5.4:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Tab bar and buttons floating on photos, with a 16–24px backdrop blur.

families.sans: -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Tab screen titles: Ce soir, Recettes, Courses, Nous.

styles.name: title-m
styles.usage: Moments and recipe titles: match, no match, recipe page.

styles.name: title-s
styles.usage: Sheet titles, recipe name on the swipe card.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headings inside a scrolling page, followed by a count badge.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Le reste ira dans la liste de courses.
styles.usage: One line of sub-copy under a title. Most screens need none.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels and overlines, in muted. Sentence case.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab bar labels under their icon.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between progress segments; icon-to-text in tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to its control.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside rows: icon to text; between cards in a dense stack.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Row and card padding; default gap between blocks on a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding when the card holds a button.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; sheet padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, keyboard-like fields.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Choice chips and fact chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, thumbnails, icon tiles at 40px.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Swipe card, hero card, sheet top corners, recipe page sheet over the photo.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, round buttons, switches, tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and white chips on paper. Tinted cards (sage, iris, accent) take no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Swipe card and floating round buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: The primary button only.
